_readme: Economy of the current build: step 'tap2' (win coins) + step 'shop' (src/main/shop.js, D-blast-SHOP / D-blast-COIN). Full rationale, Figma states and the sanity check: docs/SHOP-SPEC.md.
Real money is HIDDEN in the default build (build constant IAP_READY = false): the Shop shows no prices until the store products exist. ?iapdev=1 simulates the store, ?adsdev=1 stub ads.

Upgrades are permanent and paid with coins only. Upgrades make levels easier (Blast Power raises TNT damage, impulse and radius via powerMul; Starting TNT adds TNT): bot gates are run at zero upgrades.

winCoins.source: D-blast-COIN (tap2 R3); debris coins fly as a show only

coinBonus: Coin Bonus upgrade: win reward x (1 + 0.1 x level), level 0-5

pocket.name: Booster Pocket
pocket.effect: N free boosters granted when a Hard / Boss level opens (locked until the first booster unlocks)

slowmo.name: Slow-mo
slowmo.effect: slow-motion length 0.8 s + 0.1 s per level

ads.provider: none in the default build (no SDK); facade only
ads.rules: no interstitial after a loss, after a rewarded video, or with No Ads (full rules docs/SHOP-SPEC.md section 5.3)
